# background — Signal Bezel evidence (W4c, agent B)

- `after-*-offscreen-desktop-clock.png` — this branch, the real
  `DesktopClock` over a stand-in gradient "wallpaper", offscreen Qt harness
  with the clock's drop shadow turned off in the isolated config (the
  software capture cannot render the shadow effect). No plate is shown:
  the plate is off by default. Not a desktop capture; the desktop visualiser
  needs a live audio spectrum and is covered by static tests only.
- Themes: `night`, `day`, `hc` (Signal High Contrast).
